steps.what: Read agreed behavior goals in the pupil administration system
Prepare the behavior modification technique for this lesson
Keep the positive reinforcement tally in the workbook
Read parent mail about this pupil's behavior
Teach socially acceptable behavior using positive reinforcement

tasks.design: The teacher reads the agreed behavior goals in the {OTHER} pupil administration system, prepares the technique in {DOCS}, and teaches the behavior with the pupil. The reinforcement tally stays in the {SPREADSHEET}. Mail in {EMAIL} is only read. No model watches the pupil or suggests the technique.
tasks.previous_blocker: The technique depends on what this pupil does in the room, which a template cannot see.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the lesson. The goals are already on the pupil record for the teacher to read.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the moment to reinforce, and choosing a technique the pupil can accept today.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher is the person in the room who judges the behavior and delivers the reinforcement.
tasks.altitude: The week does not change. The teacher still teaches the behavior and still chooses the technique.

reach.task: Carry the same reinforcement through the rest of the school day
reach.learn: Which cue the assistant can use without a new plan

evidence.claim: Instruction, adapting methods, remedial help and disability strategies stay with the teacher. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Screen, workbook, mail, document and in-person shares follow the task means. Workbook 2.0 and mail 4.0 were kept. The 0.1 point over 100 was rescaled by largest remainder to 4, 2, 4, 18 and 72.

The behavior-goal contract is the goal statement, the agreed reinforcement and the technique the team already chose. The producer is the support plan in the pupil administration system, not this task. If those fields are missing, the teacher teaches from what they know and b1 still takes its full time.

The technique note and the reinforcement tally do not leave the school and are not a pupil score. The tally counts reinforcers the teacher used. The lesson is the act with the pupil, so neither note is a gated send.
Parents are outside school staff. The pupil is a learner outside staff. Reading parent mail is not a reply.
No extra upkeep: this task adds no list and no model.
Nothing here infers emotion or scores the pupil.
unknowns: Whether the agreed behavior goals are stored as fields or only as free text in the support plan.
research_questions: Which behavior-goal fields does this school's pupil administration system already store?

incremental.description: No extra upkeep. The behavior goals already sit in the pupil administration system, and no model is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The lesson is live behavior teaching with the pupil. The technique note and the tally are still written by the teacher.

tasks.short: Modify the general curriculum for these pupils

steps.what: Read the general education curriculum and the access level
Read unmet curriculum objectives from the score export
Read the weekly instructional plan from the other teacher
Rewrite curriculum text for students with disabilities

loop.purpose: Rewrite the source passage to the access level already stored for this pupil.
loop.input: The source passage, the stored reading level, and the sensory or language support named on the pupil.
loop.output: A rewritten passage at that level, with each changed sentence marked in the text.
loop.check: The teacher checks that each sentence keeps the lesson fact and matches the named level, and that no diagnostic label was added.
loop.stop: The teacher accepts the passage, or rewrites it after two drafts.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell which sentences of this passage must change for this pupil's access need.

steps.what: Modify teaching with instructional techniques and technology

tasks.design: The teacher reads the general curriculum in the {LMS} and the access level in the {OTHER} pupil administration system, then reads unmet objectives in the {SPREADSHEET} and the weekly plan in {EMAIL}. A bounded loop rewrites the passage to that stored level. The teacher accepts the text in {DOCS} before teaching it. The lesson with the pupil stays in full.
tasks.previous_blocker: A rewrite that keeps the lesson fact had no check a clerk could apply to free text, so the teacher rewrote every passage.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can now redraft a passage to a reading level that is already stored, and the teacher can reject it.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the rewritten passage still teaches this pupil the same idea, and teaching the lesson.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows which access need is real today and whether the rewrite still says the lesson.
tasks.altitude: The teacher still accepts every adapted passage and still teaches it. The only shorter work is the first draft of a text passage.

reach.role: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
reach.task: Teach the mainstream lesson this adaptation must follow
reach.learn: Which part of that lesson the pupil will meet tomorrow

evidence.claim: LessonUp: its lesson editor rewrites text at another level, summarises, translates.
Snappet: AI drafts a class activity for the lesson goal.
Annex III point 3: AI that admits pupils, evaluates learning outcomes, sets the education level or watches tests is high-risk.
Support needs in an OPP are health data (art. 9); a DPIA applies to a new pupil-data system (art. 35). Model knowledge, as the digest marks this point E1.
WOR does not apply to schools; under the WMS staff consent to tools that can monitor them, parents and pupils to pupil-data rules.

assumptions: Means shares are the task priors, already summing to 100: screens 5, workbook 4, mail 6, documents 32, in person 53. Mail 5.6 took the extra point over the workbook by largest remainder. This is not a new admin baseline.

The access-level contract is reading level, language of instruction, and sensory support. The producer is the support plan in the pupil administration system. If a field is missing, the teacher types it. If they cannot name a level, they rewrite the passage themselves and m4 keeps its full time.
The curriculum passage is produced by the learning system the school already uses. Opening it earns no labour saving. The score export is the workbook the teacher already keeps.

Only m4 is shorter, and only because the loop drafts sentences to a level already stored. Remaining 80 is not a measured study. The teacher still checks every sentence. The in-person lesson stays at 100.
The loop does not set the education level, grade the pupil, watch a test, or infer emotion. The accepted text is an internal document. The lesson does not edit it.
Support needs are health data. A Dutch school asks staff, parents and pupils under the WMS; WOR does not apply. National rules vary.
No extra upkeep: the access level and the objectives already exist. Review of the rewrite is already inside m4.
unknowns: Whether this school's general curriculum lives in the learning system or only in documents.
research_questions: Which access-level fields does the pupil administration system already store for a middle-school support plan?

already_counted.description: The teacher still reads every rewritten sentence and corrects the meaning before accepting the text.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep. The access level and the objectives already sit in the pupil record and the score export.

approvals.approved_version: adapted curriculum text accepted for this pupil

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the first draft of a text passage is shorter. A practical lesson, a missing access level, or a passage the teacher rebuilds keeps the full document time. The lesson itself stays in full.

steps.what: Read sensory language and memory goals for this pupil
Prepare the special educational strategies for this lesson
Read cognition and memory practice results in the workbook
Read the therapist note on perceptual motor skills
Employ these strategies and techniques during instruction

tasks.design: The teacher reads sensory, language and memory goals in the {OTHER} pupil administration system, prepares the strategy in {DOCS}, and employs it with the pupil during instruction. Practice results stay in the {SPREADSHEET}. The therapist note is read from {EMAIL}. No model chooses the strategy.
tasks.previous_blocker: The strategy is chosen while watching this pupil move, speak and remember, which a template cannot see.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the instruction. The goals are already on the pupil record for the teacher to read.
tasks.still_hard: Judging which strategy this pupil can use today, and doing the instruction.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher watches the pupil and changes the strategy during the lesson.
tasks.altitude: The week does not change. The teacher still chooses the strategy and still teaches it.

reach.task: Run a perceptual-motor exercise for this age group
reach.learn: Which exercise fits this pupil's sensory goal

evidence.claim: Instruction, adapting methods, remedial help and disability strategies stay with the teacher. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Screen 2.8, workbook 1.0, mail 2.5, documents 14.3 and in-person 79.5 sum to 100.1. Largest remainder rescales them to 3, 1, 3, 14 and 79. No means was dropped.

The goal contract is the sensory goal, the language goal and the memory goal already on the support plan. The producer is the pupil administration system. If a goal is missing, the teacher reads the last strategy note and s1 still takes its full time.

Practice results were recorded in earlier lessons. This task only reads them. The strategy note does not leave the school and is not a score of the pupil, so it is not a gated send. The instruction is the live act.
The pupil is a learner outside staff. Reading a therapist note is not a reply.
No extra upkeep: this task adds no list and no model.
Nothing here infers emotion or scores the pupil.
unknowns: Whether the therapist who writes the perceptual-motor note is school staff or an outside service.
research_questions: Are sensory, language and memory goals separate fields on this school's support plan?

incremental.description: No extra upkeep. The goals already sit in the pupil administration system, and no model is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The strategies are used with the pupil during instruction, and the strategy note is still written by the teacher.

tasks.short: Confer on behavioral and academic problems

steps.what: Read the pupil record on behavioral and academic problems
Read the academic score export for this pupil
Prepare notes on the behavioral and academic problems
Confer with parents or guardians to resolve problems
Confer with other teachers, counselors, and administrators
Send parents or guardians the agreed problem note

loop.purpose: Turn the teacher's own problem notes into a short note for the parent or guardian.
loop.input: The teacher's problem notes and the marks already on the pupil record.
loop.output: A short note in which each sentence is tied to a note or a mark.
loop.check: The teacher checks that each sentence traces to their note or a mark, and that no emotion or new diagnosis was added.
loop.stop: The teacher sends the note, or rewrites it after two drafts.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot phrase this pupil's problem without changing what the teacher decided to say.

tasks.design: The teacher reads the pupil record in the {OTHER} pupil administration system and the score export in the {SPREADSHEET}, prepares problem notes in {DOCS}, and confers in person. A bounded loop drafts the parent note from those notes. The teacher checks every sentence and sends the final note through {EMAIL}. Both conferences stay in full.
tasks.previous_blocker: A note to a parent had to keep the teacher's meaning about a sensitive problem, so a template could not send it.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can draft from notes the teacher already wrote, and the teacher can refuse the draft before the send.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what a parent should hear, and holding both conferences.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher decides what is said in the room and what is safe to send.
tasks.altitude: The teacher still holds both conferences and still releases the note that leaves the school. Only the first draft of that note is shorter.

reach.role: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
reach.task: Describe the academic problem seen in the mainstream class
reach.learn: What the mainstream teacher has already tried

evidence.claim: A model can draft a pupil comment from the teacher's own notes, and the teacher checks that each sentence traces to a mark or a note. Model knowledge.
Annex III point 3: AI that admits pupils, evaluates learning outcomes, sets the education level or watches tests is high-risk.
Support needs in an OPP are health data (art. 9); a DPIA applies to a new pupil-data system (art. 35). Model knowledge, as the digest marks this point E1.

assumptions: Screen 2.7, workbook 0.6, mail 14.5, documents 16.8 and in-person 65.5 sum to 100.1. Largest remainder rescales them to 3, 1, 14, 17 and 65.

The 65 in-person points are split 33 with parents or guardians and 32 with other teachers, counselors and administrators so the two conversations have different authority. That split is not a timing study. Both stay at remaining 100, so the split saves nothing.
Parents and guardians are outside school staff. Other teachers, counselors and administrators are treated as colleagues. The staff conference produces no separate record.
The problem notes are a draft the conferences can still change, so they are not gated. The gated act is the note that is sent after the conferences. The send does not edit the pupil record.

The mark contract is subject, recent result and date, already stored by the pupil administration system from earlier assessment. The loop does not create marks, grade the pupil, or infer emotion. If the teacher writes every sentence, c6 keeps its full time.
Remaining 80 on the send is not a measured study. It is the drafting of wording from notes the teacher already wrote. Review of that draft is already inside c6.
A note that repeats support needs is health data. National rules vary. No extra upkeep: the record and the scores already exist.
unknowns: Whether the counselor is employed by the school. If the counselor is an outside service, that part of the conference is a conversation with someone outside staff.
research_questions: Does this school expect a written note to parents after a problem conference, or only the meeting?

already_counted.description: The teacher still reads the drafted note and decides what the parent is told before sending it.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep. The pupil record and the scores already exist, and the teacher sends only the note they already had to write.

approvals.approved_version: problem note sent to the parent or guardian

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the wording of the parent note is drafted from notes the teacher already wrote. A sensitive problem is written in full, and both conferences stay in full.

role.altitude: The teacher still teaches behavior and sensory strategies in the room, still accepts every adapted passage, and still decides what parents are told.
reach: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
skills_to_grow: Judging whether a rewritten passage still teaches the lesson
Judging what a parent should be told about a problem
role.ambitious_version: The teacher still leads the lesson and still releases every note that leaves the school.
